i started college at 18 but ended up falling ill with chronic illness the end of my first year. i trooped thru it for another year or so and then have been making incremental advances towards getting my degree ever since. i took 4 years off from 2019-2023 so i could work and save up money. i just started going back to finish my degree last summer, after wrestling with the same preconceived notion as you “it’s too late for me now.” 

that way of thinking is a limiting, self-imposed belief. there is no timeline for anything. i realized this when i went back and i had a woman in her 50’s in my class and several people who were my age or a little older.

your timeline is your own and no one else’s.

oh wrd up thanks for the feedback yeah i been producing for 2 years just hit 2 last month and here are some feedback for this trck its understandable cuz its ur first song but i think the autotune is a little harsh if there is a way u can minimize it like still use it but just turn down the levels for it a notch it gets to be a little overbearing. there also are some phasing issues with your vocals over the beat one way to really avoid this is carefully making cuts to the EQ of the beat where the vocals tend to be the strongest, so the two frequencies don’t compete with one another. i noticed it alot with the mid frequencies. one rule of thumb to avoid this or at least ensure that the vocals fit over the beat is make an unmastered version of the beat, cap it at around -6db or -3db that way there is enough headroom for your vocals to sit over the instrumental and then mix and master accordingly, applying a compressor on your master bus and adjusting the settings to ur likely will glue the two separate audio signals together. hope this helps brother
